scope: 21 user-facing/maintainer applications:17 Rust creative/analysis tools, ArtCraft, ArtCraft-X, AutoCraft and Craft Launcher. The other source repositories are libraries, infrastructure or research, not additional complete applications.
publicDemoVerification: No invented hosted-app URLs. Release pages were inspected and17 actual webZIPs were downloaded with upstream checksum/signature checks.
verificationScope: Source architecture and documented gaps are inspected. Actual app feature tests and native/browser parity are unrun by this inventory audit.

githubPagesCanServe: Browser local computation, file-pickers/downloads and browser storage
HTTPS entry pages for GPU/clipboard/browser-storage APIs
githubPagesCannotExecute: A Node/Rust server or SQLite service
Tauri native IPC, local process spawning or arbitrary OS filesystem operations
Provider secrets, OAuth callback services, persistent worker queues or server cron
Native app installation/update/launch, native ffmpeg processes or OS audio/device capture through the unchanged native app
hosting.headerCaveat: GitHub Pages does not apply Netlify _headers or Apache .htaccess files. Current inspected wasm hosting docs say SharedArrayBuffer/isolation headers are not required, but a future threaded build must be re-evaluated.
hosting.sizeCaveat: The17 verified webZIPs expand to706.7MiB. Measure the existing published site and individual files before adding them to a1GiB GitHub Pages site; VectorCraft has a97.5MiB single file.
hosting.fullFunctionalityRequirement: Full native functionality requires the actual native app or a deliberately implemented native/server companion for the documented missing capabilities. Serving a mock frontend, source catalogue or limited browser viewer does not satisfy it.
